title: CSFM Strut and Tie Surrogate: dataset-generation pipeline, dataset, trained models and evaluation code
description:
Dataset-generation pipeline, generated dataset, trained model weights and evaluation code for a neural-network surrogate of a discrete strut and tie solver that applies the Compatible Stress Field Method (CSFM) constitutive laws to four concrete D-region archetypes (deep beam, hammerhead pier, multi-column bent, pile cap).

Contents: the TypeScript solver core and the Latin-hypercube sweep that generated the training data; the datasets (750 designs per archetype, three out-of-domain shells, a two-point-load deep-beam variant, and the pier-cap experimental benchmark); the PyTorch training, evaluation, uncertainty (bagged ensemble with split-conformal calibration), out-of-domain and design-optimisation code with the trained checkpoints and ensembles; and additional experiments (equilibrium-weight sweep, least-squares equilibrium projection, censoring-aware loss, network-width sweep, member-force conformal intervals, out-of-domain detection curve, retraining for a changed loading configuration, and the check of the solver against the pier-cap tests of Geevar and Menon and the deep-beam tests of Li et al. 2022).
